data.title: 幽灵鲨 · 潮音白石阶上的咏叹
data.action: 优雅单手提着微湿的黑白裙摆，一步步踏入清凉海水，另一只手轻抚过长卷银发，嘴角挂着难以捉摸而优雅沉醉的微笑，微微昂首倾听潮鸣
data.location: 临海旧教堂废墟坍塌入海的白大理石台阶
data.lighting: 晨雾中穿透的冷冽天光与微弱暖曦
data.mood: 优雅癫狂、哥特神秘、唯美从容
data.description: 旧日海滨教堂废墟的破晓清晨。幽灵鲨身着深渊雕塑家复古修女风束腰泳裙，提着荷叶裙摆缓缓步入海浪。清冷晨雾从海面蒸腾，她轻抚微湿的银色卷发，倾听着潮水拍打残柱的声响，笑容中兼具艺术家的狂热与深海血脉的幽玄。
data.promptProse: Specter descends the submerged white marble steps of a ruined seaside chapel into the dawn tide, wearing a gothic black-and-white boned corset swimdress with tiered lace ruffles and a cross choker. Lifting one damp edge of her skirt while brushing back her wet white curls, she offers a serene, enigmatic smile through cool morning mist.
data.animaCaption: Stepping down submerged white marble ruins into cool morning surf in a black-and-white gothic corset swimdress, she lifts her damp ruffled hem with one hand while brushing wet curls back with the other. Pale mist drifts around the broken columns in soft dawn light.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a gothic nun-inspired black-and-white boned corset swimdress with tiered ruffled lace skirts and a cross-motif choker.
